name: office_crazyflie
description: Three office layouts (playground preset office_0 and benchmark office layouts 1 and 2), stock vehicle, Crazyflie Multi-ranger preset (4 cone beams, 3 m). Bar: reach B in at least 90 % of runs, 0 collisions in at least seeds x worlds = 15 distinct runs (a count rule, not a rate claim), median time to B at most 30 s.
